name: Journey to Tarren Mill
summary: Apothecary Zamah seeks a way to drive the Venture Company from Stonetalon Mountains without open war. She sends you across the sea to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill, where the Royal Apothecary Society works in Lordaeron.

sections.title: A Plea Across the Great Sea
sections.body: In Thunder Bluff, Apothecary Zamah is a link between the Forsaken and the Earth Mother's children. The Venture Company is logging and mining the sacred lands of Stonetalon Mountains, and the tauren have found that ordinary methods will not stop them. Zamah turns to her peers in the Royal Apothecary Society for a chemical deterrent. She hopes their alchemy can drive the company out without a drawn-out war.

sections.title: The Road to Hillsbrad
sections.body: You cross the sea from Kalimdor by zeppelin toward Lordaeron and the Undercity. From Tirisfal Glades, the road leads south through Silverpine Forest and into the contested Hillsbrad Foothills. Tarren Mill lies near human farmsteads and ruins. Once a human hamlet, it is now a Forsaken stronghold and a place where the Royal Apothecary Society carries out its research.

sections.title: Apothecary Lydon's Craft
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon works in Tarren Mill with volatile chemistry and biological agents. Lydon sometimes tests mixtures on living subjects. Zamah's note explains the problem with the Venture Company, and Lydon eagerly takes it up. The Society welcomes a chance to test its compounds in a new place, and Lydon begins preparing reagents for the goblins.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Zamah send me all the way to Tarren Mill?
faq.answer: Apothecary Zamah needs a concoction to drive the Venture Company from Stonetalon Mountains without open war. Her colleague Apothecary Lydon works with the Royal Apothecary Society in Tarren Mill and can prepare the alchemical compounds she needs.

aliases: how do i get to tarren mill
faq.answer: Tarren Mill is in the northern Hillsbrad Foothills on Lordaeron. From Kalimdor, take a zeppelin from Durotar to the Undercity in Tirisfal Glades, then travel south through Silverpine Forest and east into Hillsbrad.

faq.q: Who are Apothecary Zamah and Apothecary Lydon?
faq.answer: Apothecary Zamah and Apothecary Lydon belong to the Forsaken Royal Apothecary Society. Zamah works in the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff, studying local plants and helping the tauren, while Lydon conducts alchemical and plague experiments in Tarren Mill.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken helping with the Venture Company in Stonetalon?
aliases: why do forsaken care about stonetalon
faq.answer: The Forsaken joined the Horde for survival and convenience, and the tauren spoke up to secure their place in the faction. Helping the tauren against the Venture Company strengthens that alliance and gives Forsaken alchemists a place to test their work.

faq.q: What is the Royal Apothecary Society?
aliases: what is the royal apothecary society
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society is an order of Forsaken alchemists and scientists based beneath the ruins of Lordaeron in the Undercity. Under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner's direction, they develop elixirs, poisons, and blight strains to defend the Forsaken and destroy their enemies.

faq.q: What happens after delivering the note to Lydon?
aliases: next quest after journey to tarren mill
faq.answer: After receiving Zamah's request, Apothecary Lydon begins preparing a solution. To make a suitable mixture, you need to collect vials of innocent blood from the Syndicate shadow mages at Durnholde Keep.

angles.text: As a tauren, the defilement of Stonetalon cuts deep. Accepting Forsaken alchemy means making uneasy compromises to protect your sacred lands.
As an undead, you see how the Royal Apothecary Society carries its chemical knowledge across the sea to help distant Horde allies.
As a member of the Horde, you travel between Thunder Bluff and Tarren Mill, joining young defenders to allies across the sea.
